name: FAULT_TAG_LIFECYCLE_V1
draft: membership editable only while current tag state=draft
pickup method may remain temporarily incomplete in UI draft but submission requires exactly one pickup-origin Dispatch Location
draft membership must reference one open RMA obligation, exact current selected typed unit and supporting physical consequence
submission: revalidate all memberships and exclusivity in one UnitOfWork
freeze tag/membership snapshots and append submitted events
active_submitted uniqueness is enforced independently for RMA obligation and typed unit
submission artifact generation alone has no authority
warehouse: warehouse_received is per membership and leaves RMA obligation open
final accepted/rejected is per membership and always requires explicit operator confirmation
accepted closes obligation; rejected leaves/reopens obligation and removes active submitted exclusivity
partial progression never affects other memberships
tag terminal aggregate occurs only when every submitted membership is accepted/rejected/cancelled/superseded
false_submission_correction: allowed only when no real external submission occurred and downstream evidence does not contradict claim
preserve old event/snapshot as corrected history
restore same tag to draft and unlock current draft membership
material_replacement: create new Fault Tag/new tracking id/new membership identities
predecessor becomes superseded and one corrects_replaces edge is appended
lineage must remain acyclic/linear and replacement must be independently submitted later
resend: requires genuine rejected membership with open return obligation
create new Fault Tag/new membership identities and resend_of edge
selected resend scopes from one predecessor must not overlap each other while active
archive: presentation only; unresolved obligations remain visible in Needs Attention and lineage
hard_delete: only untouched manual draft with no generation/proposal/submission/correction/warehouse/lineage/protected dependency; never cascades independently surviving entities/artifacts
